name: MediaFolderPicker
summary: On-demand destination browsing for atomic move/copy commands.
usage: Use within MediaDialog, with source identities/scopes and the action. Loads paginated visible folders rather than the entire tree. Scope and descendant hints improve choice; server validation remains authoritative.
accessibility: Named native breadcrumb and folder buttons, visible scope hints, loading/error feedback and a disabled confirmation for incompatible or unresolved destinations.

props.name: sourceFolderIds
props.meaning: Selected folders to exclude as destinations.

props.name: onReload
props.meaning: Reconciles unknown outcomes or refreshes stale selection.

examples.label: Move destination
examples.code: <MediaFolderPicker companyId={companyId} initialId={null} action="MOVE" sourceFolderIds={ids} sourceScopes={scopes} pending={pending} error={error} onReload={reload} onChoose={move} />
